comment: Vectores compartidos de AgentTemplate (ai-agent-fast-start): mismas opciones, mismo Dockerfile, manifiesto, start_cmd y ficheros de contexto en Python y TypeScript.

cases.name: default
cases.dockerfile:
# >>> rayito template layer (m15-templates), no editar a mano
RUN curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/opencode.tar.gz https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/download/v1.18.34/opencode-linux-arm64.tar.gz && echo 'bbdb3f00c2c51e42e315525233151309724226a8776da8e9145e3b0fa3d5310f  /tmp/opencode.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c - && curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/releases/download/15.2.0/ripgrep-15.2.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && echo 'a740b91c82eaf9914cfedd353572f2791cbe0162c84101ee0951058f4dcbc90d  /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c - && mkdir -p /opt/agents/bin && tar -xzf /tmp/opencode.tar.gz -C /opt/agents/bin opencode && tar -xzf /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz -C /tmp && mv /tmp/ripgrep-15.2.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/rg /opt/agents/bin/rg && rm -rf /tmp/opencode.tar.gz /tmp/ripgrep.tar.gz /tmp/ripgrep-15.2.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && chown -R root:root /opt/agents && chmod 0755 /opt/agents /opt/agents/bin /opt/agents/bin/opencode /opt/agents/bin/rg && ln -sf /opt/agents/bin/opencode /usr/local/bin/opencode && ln -sf /opt/agents/bin/rg /usr/local/bin/rg
COPY ["__rayito_context/requirements-deepagents.txt", "/opt/agents/requirements-deepagents.txt"]
RUN echo 'edd561e5f3d91ab3b4784809dfa0f7a8eb0d6f3d8a4ccb1a57dcdf63982bacaa  /opt/agents/requirements-deepagents.txt' | sha256sum -c - && python3 -m venv /opt/agents/deepagents && /opt/agents/deepagents/bin/python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary=:all: -r /opt/agents/requirements-deepagents.txt && /opt/agents/deepagents/bin/python -m pip check
COPY ["__rayito_context/deepagents_runner.py", "/opt/agents/rayito/deepagents_runner.py"]
COPY ["__rayito_context/rayito-agent.json", "/opt/agents/rayito-agent.json"]
COPY ["__rayito_context/rayito-agent-prefetch", "/opt/agents/bin/rayito-agent-prefetch"]
RUN mkdir -p /opt/agents/bin && chown -R root:root /opt/agents && chmod -R a+rX,go-w /opt/agents && chmod 0755 /opt/agents/rayito/deepagents_runner.py /opt/agents/bin/rayito-agent-prefetch
ENV OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE="1"
ENV OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH="1"
ENV OPENCODE_DISABLE_LSP_DOWNLOAD="1"
ENV OPENCODE_DISABLE_DEFAULT_PLUGINS="1"
ENV OPENCODE_PURE="1"
ENV OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE="1"
ENV OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_WEBSOCKETS="0"
RUN su user -c 'opencode --version' && su user -c 'rg --version' && su user -c "/opt/agents/deepagents/bin/python -c 'import deepagents, langchain_aws, langchain_anthropic, langchain_openai, langchain_google_genai'" && su user -c 'test -r /opt/agents/rayito/deepagents_runner.py'
COPY ["__rayito_template.json", "/etc/rayito/template.json"]
# <<< rayito template layer
